dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-frequency stippled edges are visible. Three prominent rings in the upper central region demonstrate a sharp gradient from a dark dorsal background to a high-intensity perimeter with a lower-intensity center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid-fill high-intensity pixel clusters is observed along the upper dorsal line, where textural patterns converge into more amorphous light regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle in the upper-mid dorsal region, with a secondary linear alignment of blobs extending towards the posterior extremity.

other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge of the posterior flipper displays a distinctive notched or serrated geometric profile.
